user.title: Room Advisor
user.description:
Room Advisor tells you what is worth doing in each room, and why, as entities your automations can use.

This hub holds the inputs and default settings that every room inherits, so you only set them once. Everything here is optional, and any room can override what it inherits.

Add your rooms next.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. There is one Room Advisor hub per house; add each room to the existing hub.

user.title: Add a room
user.description:
Pick the area this room covers. Room Advisor suggests the entities already assigned to it, and you confirm them in a later step.

A room does not have to match an area. If yours does not, leave the area empty and just give it a name.

data_description.area_id: Used to suggest this room's entities and to file its device. Nothing reads it afterwards.
data_description.name: Leave empty to name the room after its area.

reconfigure.title: Rename or move room
reconfigure.description: Rename this room, or point it at a different area. Its advice keeps the same entity IDs either way, so anything already using them keeps working.

data_description.area_id: Used to suggest this room's entities and to file its device. Nothing reads it afterwards.
data_description.name: Leave empty to name the room after its area.

error.unknown_area: That area no longer exists. Pick another one, or leave it empty and name the room yourself.
error.name_required: Give the room a name, or pick an area to name it after.
